snapshot.capital_scaled: ₹50 lakh–2 crore for your own plant, cold chain and parlours
snapshot.distribution_note: Freezer space and cold chain are the big barriers

tailwinds: Premium, healthy and artisanal ice creams are growing fast in cities.
Quick-commerce apps deliver frozen desserts in minutes.
Sugar-free, protein and vegan desserts attract new buyers.
Regional and Indian flavours like gulkand and filter coffee appeal to buyers.
headwinds: Amul, Havmor and Kwality Wall's dominate freezers.
Cold chain is expensive, and one power cut can destroy stock.
Ingredients like milk and cream keep getting more expensive.
angle_2026: Quick commerce has solved the delivery problem for small ice cream brands in metros. In 2026, the brands that grow own a clear niche, such as healthy, artisanal or regional flavours, and start with parlours or quick commerce instead of fighting for retail freezers.
cost_basis: Estimated for a small brand using a co-manufacturer or a small production unit, selling in one city, 2026 prices.

setup_costs.covers: Batch freezer, pasteuriser, hardening freezer, or co-manufacturing fees

unit_economics.note: Cold chain and wastage decide profits. Track every melt and power cut.

investor_probes: How do you keep the cold chain unbroken?
What share of sales comes in summer?
How do you get freezer space?
bootstrap_takeaway: Start with a small parlour or quick-commerce sales in one city, and add retail only once buyers reorder.
sourcing_edge: Buying milk and cream directly from dairies lowers cost. Sharing cold storage and delivery with other brands cuts overheads.

hard_truths.title: Cold chain
hard_truths.text: Ice cream must stay frozen from production to customer. Every break costs money.

hard_truths.title: Winter slump
hard_truths.text: Sales can halve in winter. Add desserts or hot products.

hard_truths.title: Freezer space
hard_truths.text: Big brands give free freezers to retailers. You'll struggle for space.

hard_truths.title: Ingredient costs
hard_truths.text: Milk and cream prices keep rising. Review prices often.

plan_goal: The aim is 2,000 units sold, with steady reorders from outlets.

plan.title: Recipes
steps: Find a co-manufacturer or plan production.

plan.title: Review the numbers
steps: Decide on next flavours or outlets.
